articles.availability_note: Catch-up edition: prepared for 2026-11-06; first published November 13, 2026. WHO’s November 4 recommendation awaits national approvals; it establishes a trial step, with efficacy against Bundibugyo still to be measured. ECDC’s November 5 page reports 10,668 confirmed DRC cases and 5,198 deaths using data through November 3. Ervebo and treatment approvals cited by CDC concern Zaire ebolavirus. Trial rings, country totals, medical evacuations and geographic risk assessments have distinct scopes.
